source_inspection.current_maker: Research Lead process calls KimiClient.complete for each of seven role reports through the local Moonshot API.
source_inspection.publication_binding: kimi_daily.inspect_generation checks one generation transport and model against all seven per-role run.json request records.
source_inspection.remote_roles: multica_reviews binds six distinct remote reviewer identities to a frozen package after Research Lead publication and prevents reviewer task reuse as the publisher task.
source_inspection.missing_contract: There is no per-role independent remote maker identity, task receipt, runtime/model provenance and no cross-check that a report maker differs from its reviewer.

decision: Do not inject an unbound remote-made report into a production or M2 generation receipt. Do not create a cosmetic maker task that cannot satisfy source verification. Keep the current sole publication and independent review path unchanged for the next natural-day M2 candidate.
future_acceptance_boundary: After the natural-day M2/M3 chain, define a versioned per-report provenance contract, bind each maker task and output hash to the frozen inputs, reject same-identity self-review, and validate in isolation before any production switch; retain old generation receipts and failed runs.
